facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy and Finance has relied since 2013 on a backup platform for its information systems managed by an external provider (main site presumably Rabat, not stated; backup place not stated); the 2026 tender of about MAD 5 million would expand it.

The ministry frames the tender as part of updating its business continuity plan; the tender requires a data centre more than 100 km from Rabat (backup place not stated; main site in Rabat) and 30 km from the coast, with Tier III preferred and ISO 22301.
